description: This file defines the Host class interface for device settings management, including power modes, display connections, audio/video ports, and device information. It appears to be a stub or mock implementation used for unit testing within the device namespace.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Class implementing device host interface with methods for power management, port access, and device info.

methods.name: setPowerMode
methods.description: Sets the power mode; stub implementation always returns true.

methods.name: getPowerMode
methods.description: Returns a fixed power mode value (10).

methods.name: getAvailableSleepModes
methods.description: Returns a list of available sleep modes.

methods.name: addPowerModeListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for power mode changes.

methods.name: removePowerModeChangeListener
methods.description: Removes a power mode change listener.

methods.name: addDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for display connection changes.

methods.name: removeDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Removes a display connection change listener.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of Host.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPorts
methods.description: Returns a list of video output ports.

methods.name: getAudioOutputPorts
methods.description: Returns a list of audio output ports.

methods.name: getVideoDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of video devices.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPort
methods.description: Returns a reference to a video output port by name or id.

methods.name: getAudioOutputPort
methods.description: Returns a reference to an audio output port by name or id.

methods.name: notifyPowerChange
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a power mode change.

methods.name: getCPUTemperature
methods.description: Returns a fixed CPU temperature value.

methods.name: setAudioAtmosOutputMode
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos output mode.

methods.name: isHDMIOutPortPresent
methods.description: Checks if HDMI output port is present.
